text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaargggh! I can't believe I got injured
this baaad!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Shiraoki, why have you forsaken meeee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but it's such a serious
injury... This is
decisive proof that the
great Shiraoki is no longer
looking out
for me!
choice_data_list: I feel like that's an exaggeration...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urk... Who even am I without the grace
of
Shiraoki?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm a fried egg with no yolk!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hic... We should... I'd like to plead to my case to Shiraoki.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll say that I still have more potential in
me...
That I'll work really hard... So
please... don't
abandon my pitiful,
no-good self.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But should my plea go ignored, I'll...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm w-willing to give my precious
5,000-yen bill
as an offering...

We go to a nearby shrine together, but
neither
Matikanefukukitaru's spirits nor
her motivation
show much sign of
returning. This situation has
really
dampened her mood.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh?! T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urk... I think it's amazing how you're able
to say
stuff like that so confidently.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm so wishy-washy in comparison. We're
like
apples and oranges. Except I'm just
a crab apple
and you're an... orange.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just a sad little craaab apple.

Being miserable doesn't help with
healing
injuries... It takes a long time for
her to make a
full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But... I have no one left. I'm all alone...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'll work really hard... I promise!

Matikanefukukitaru and I both focus our
efforts
on recovery, determined to get
back to training!
